events.title: Don Mackay becomes the first managerial casualty of the season when he is sacked by 블랙번 로버스 after more than four years in charge. Coach Tony Parkes is appointed caretaker manager. Within hours of his dismissal, Graham Carr resigns from Fourth Division side Maidstone United (deep in debt and reportedly at threat of closure in only their third season as a Football League club) after eight months at the helm, with the club's general manager, Bill Williams taking over as first-team manager for the third time in his career.

17-year-old winger 라이언 긱스 scores his first league goal of the season in 맨체스터 유나이티드's 3–0 home win over 노리치 시티 . A mere 3,231 fans watch 윔블던's home game against 루턴 타운 – the lowest postwar attendance at a First Division game.
A year into his reign as England manager, 그레이엄 테일러 sees the national side lose for the first time when they go down 1–0 to a reunified Germany side in a friendly at Wembley.
아스널 beat a 크리스털 팰리스 side containing their transfer target 이언 라이트 4–1 in the league at Selhurst Park . Kevin Campbell scores twice.
Nigel Jemson , the striker whose goal won the League Cup for 노팅엄 포리스트 17 months ago , moves to 셰필드 웬즈데이 for £800,000.

Dean Saunders becomes the first player to score four goals in a European game for 리버풀 as they defeat Kuusysi Lahti 6–1 at Anfield in the UEFA Cup first round first leg, but John Barnes suffers an achilles injury and is ruled out until the new year. Alan Smith of 아스널 also scores four in a 6–1 European win – at home to Austria Vienna in the European Cup first round first leg.
토트넘 홋스퍼 defender Terry Fenwick , 31, is sentenced to four months in prison for drink-driving .

First Division leaders 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat struggling 루턴 타운 5–0 at Old Trafford , with 브라이언 매클레어 and 마크 휴스 both scoring twice. Peter Beardsley scores a hat-trick in 에버턴's 3–0 home win over Coventry, and 게리 리네커 scores four goals in 토트넘 홋스퍼's 5–3 away win over 윔블던.
아스널 pay a club record £2.5million for 크리스털 팰리스 striker 이언 라이트. Palace manager 스티브 코펠 uses the windfall from the transfer to pay Palace's record fee of £1.8million for 선덜랜드 striker Marco Gabbiadini .
Asgeir Eliasson makes his debut as the manager of Iceland with a 2–0 win over Spain .
이언 라이트 scores a hat-trick on his league debut for 아스널 in a 4–0 win at 사우샘프턴 .

맨체스터 유나이티드 lead the First Division by six points from 리즈 유나이티드 at the end of September. 셰필드 유나이티드 are bottom of the table, with only one league win from eleven games. The Second Division is being led by a thriving 미들즈브러 side in their first season under the management of Lennie Lawrence . 입스위치 타운 occupy second place. 스윈던 타운 , 울버햄프턴 원더러스, 레스터 시티 and 케임브리지 유나이티드 occupy the playoff zone.
